queue_results.name: Job admission burst with two parked workers

external_services: Disabled; no real Groq, GitHub imports or Docker execution. All storage under ignored tmp/security-load; production data was not targeted.
load_generator: Same laptop as the server; one Uvicorn process; 2,000 seeded accounts/sessions; maximum 400 in-flight read requests and 100 in-flight submissions. Not 2,000 simultaneous real migrations.

findings.title: Unbounded job admission and no per-user quota
findings.evidence: Confirmed: 1,000 HTTP 200 submissions, two parked workers and 998 queued tasks.
findings.improvement: Bound the global queue, enforce per-user active/queued/cost/storage limits, return 429/503 with Retry-After, and reserve capacity before writing files.

findings.title: Legacy API limits differ from the main job route
findings.evidence: Confirmed: /api/parse accepted a 1MB PHP source; main jobs accept only 45,000 source characters. /api/migrate bypasses job admission by code inspection; not invoked against a real provider.
findings.improvement: Apply uniform body/source/rate limits and move model calls behind the same bounded job service; remove unused legacy endpoints.

findings.title: Windows case collisions overwrite submitted source
findings.evidence: Confirmed: Case.php and case.php accepted as two sources, but one physical PHP file remained with the second contents.
findings.improvement: Canonicalize Unicode and filesystem case rules, detect collisions and file/directory conflicts before any write; use platform-safe paths.

findings.title: Rejected requests leave orphan directories
findings.evidence: Confirmed: three NUL-containing filename requests returned 400 but added three unowned job folders.
findings.improvement: Validate all paths before allocation; transactional staging and cleanup on failure; disk quotas and artifact retention.

findings.title: API latency degrades significantly with concurrency
findings.evidence: Observed: p95 0.561s at 25, 2.408s at 100, 10.667s at 400 in-flight read requests; two transport failures at the largest stage. No server-500 response in read stages.
findings.improvement: Move synchronous database/disk work off the event loop, initialize schema once, store lightweight status separately from source/report artifacts, use polling backoff/SSE; profile before database migration. SQLite is not by itself proven to be the sole bottleneck.

findings.title: Shared-IP login throttle can block unrelated valid users
findings.evidence: Confirmed: 35 failed logins yielded 30x401 and 5x429; a different valid fixture account then received 429 from the same client IP.
findings.improvement: Use combined IP/account/global adaptive rate controls with atomic counters and concurrency limits; consider shared campus/NAT users.

findings.title: Queued work is process-local rather than durable
findings.evidence: Code review: ThreadPoolExecutor queue has no restart requeue/reconciliation. This test did not claim a successful restart recovery.
findings.improvement: Use a durable queue and separate workers, leases/heartbeats, idempotency, cancellation and explicit interrupted/failed states.

findings.title: Security scanner has demonstrated false positives and misses
findings.evidence: Confirmed without executing PHP: commented system($x) was flagged HIGH; a dynamically assembled command function call was missed.
findings.improvement: Integrate maintained Semgrep/Bandit checks, AST/data-flow analysis where possible, findings provenance and tests for known false positives/negatives.

findings.title: Host-side Docker output capture is unbounded
findings.evidence: Code review only: subprocess.run(capture_output=True) collects untrusted stdout/stderr without a byte cap. No memory-exhaustion or Docker-breakout attack was executed.
findings.improvement: Bound streamed output and result sizes; use named/labeled containers with explicit timeout kill/removal, verify cleanup and isolate execution workers.

findings.title: Migration correctness and supply-chain checks remain incomplete
findings.evidence: Earlier calculator run completed with class behavior UNTESTED; this load test uses deterministic fixtures. Python compilation does not verify dependencies or behavior.
findings.improvement: Add class/HTTP characterization and independent grading inputs; version cache entries by model/prompt/helper version, validate imports and dependencies, review generated project security before deployment.

positive_controls: Invalid CSRF and cross-origin mutations/login returned 403
